findings.note: ESPN's game page confirms Gasser starts against Freddy Peralta. It lists his postseason line as 9.0 IP with only 6 strikeouts, which works out to about 3 Ks per start in two short outings, under the 3.5 line.

ESPN's World Series preview calls Milwaukee's starters after Misiorowski and Henderson, Gasser included, 'relatively uninspiring.' It says Pat Murphy will lean more on his bullpen in Games 3 and 4, which points to a short leash and fewer batters faced.

MLB.com's Game 3 preview confirms Gasser starts Monday 8 ET at Tropicana Field with a 1.51 ERA in eight appearances since Aug. 26. He has started clinching or pivotal games in the NLDS and NLCS, so the team trusts him. His regular season was 103 K in 109.1 IP, per Savant.
